column1: # C17: in the BEAST 3 XML the ORC rate prior's S is a separate hyper-parameter with the same
# Gamma(5, 0.05) prior, and ORCsigma is not connected to the rates (it samples its prior only).
# The BEAST 2 ORCsigma corresponds to that hyper-parameter. C16, from the same template, has ORC's
# BranchRatePrior with sigma=@ORCsigma, so this looks like a Priors-panel edit; C17 is to be rebuilt.
